title: Colpey Calling x The Fix [11] with Emanative
content:
24th July 2015

This week we welcomed Emanative, the music project of Nick Woodmansey, whose recent collaborations with the likes of Four Tet, The Pyramids and Ahmed Abdullah produced one of the finest albums of 2015, The Light Years of the Darkness. With selections including Don Cherry, Bengt Berger and Ruby Rushton, he treated us to an hour of beautiful music, which we sandwiched with some jazz selections of our own.
